title: double-check on response body size: both Content-Length and actual bytes
description: fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob all check Content-Length header first (early exit) and then also check bytes.len() after buffering. Comment explains 'Content-Length can lie'. A contributor might remove the post-read check as redundant — it is not redundant, Content-Length is an advisory header and can be omitted or falsified. Both checks are necessary.
